# The directory structure for CBDB-Desktop

```text
The directory structure for CBDB-Desktop will be:
Note: the structure has been revised to integrate the QBE form into the CBDB main framework while keeping the Stand-alone version separate

Executables: CBDB-Desktop\Bin
	CBDB-Desktop\Bin\CBDB.exe
	CBDB-Desktop\Bin\CBDBSetup.exe
	CBDB-Desktop\Bin\CBDBQuery.exe
HTML/JS files: 
	Templates for CBDB.exe
	HTML/JS file for Association-Pairs: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\association_pairs\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Associations: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\associations\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Browser: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\browser\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Entry: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\entry\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Group-data: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\group_data\index.html
	HTML/JS file for the Index Address form: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\index_addr\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Kinship: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\kinship\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Navigation: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\navigation\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Networks: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\networks\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Office-holding: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\office\index.html
	HTML/JS files for picker files: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\pickers\
	HTML/JS file for Status: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\status\index.html
	HTML/JS file for Texts: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\texts\index.html
	HTML/JS file for QBE: CBDB-Desktop\Templates\qbe\qbe.html

	Template for Stand-alone CBDBSetup.exe
	HTML/JS file: CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpTemplate\maintenance.html

	Template for Stand-alone CBDBQuery.exe
	HTML/JS file: CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Template\qbe.html

CSS file: CBDB-Desktop\Static\cbdb_styles.css

Code files: 
	Code for CBDB.exe
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\associations_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\assocpairs_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\browser_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\cbdb_navigation_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\entry_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\groupdata_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\indexaddr_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\kinship_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\main.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\networks_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\office_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\status_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\texts_form_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_criteria.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_gridstate.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_main.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_handlers.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_request.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_schema.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\qbe_sqlgen.go
	CBDB-Desktop\Code\gen_qbe_schema.py (the Python code to convert the schema in CBDB.db.schema.sql into the whitelist JSON file)

	Code for Stand-alone CBDBSetup.exe
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\indexaddress_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\indexyear_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\main.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\maintenance_routes_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\provision_schema_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\zzzaddresses_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\zzzdistance_backend.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBSetUpCode\zzznames_backend.go

	Code for Stand-alone CBDBQuery.exe
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\criteria.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\gridstate.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\main.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\qbe_handlers.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\request.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\schema.go
	CBDB-Desktop\CBDBQuery\Code\sqlgen.go

SQLite database files: 
	CBDB-Desktop\Data\CBDB.db
	CBDB-Desktop\Data\CBDB_new.db (this is the database used by CBDBSetup to create an updated revision of CBDB.db)
	CBDB-Desktop\Data\CBDB.db.schema.sql (the schema for CBDB.db)
	CBDB-Desktop\Data\qbe_schema.json (needed for the QBE code)

PDF files: CBDB-Desktop\Static\xxx.pdf
```
